Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7327); Ruth, a Moabitess:--Ruth.
BiblicalUsage: Booz begat Obed of Ruth, and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David the king. Ruth the Moabitess, who clave to Naomi and to Naomi's God, is written into the line of the King.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that Ruth is in the genealogy because loyalty is a better pedigree than birth.
